title: Haloumi and Moroccan-Spiced Rice Salad
subtitle: with Roast Beetroot and Pepitas
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

ingredients.name: Brown and Black Rice with Quinoa

steps.text: Cook rice blend: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil. Add the rice blend and 3 tsp Moroccan seasoning and cook for 22-24 mins until tender. Drain.

Roast beetroot: Meanwhile, peel the beetroot and cut into 2cm-thick wedges (see Kitchen 101). Put on the lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Roast for 20 mins. Scatter over the pepitas and roast for a further 3-4 mins until the beetroot is tender and the pepitas are toasted.

Cook haloumi: While the beetroot is roasting, combine the 1 tsp Moroccan seasoning, 2 tbs mayonnaise and 1 tsp water in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Slice the haloumi. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove from the pan.

Make salad: Combine 2 tsp olive oil, 2 tsp red wine vinegar and ½ tsp sugar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the salad leaves, roasted beetroot, pepitas and rice blend and toss to combine.

Serve up: Combine the 1 tsp Moroccan seasoning, 2 tbs mayonnaise and 1 tsp water in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Divide the salad and haloumi among plates, drizzle with the Moroccan mayo and enjoy!
Kitchen 101: Beetroot can be messy to prepare and can stain your hands, so wear gloves if you prefer.
